name: Tom Stack
bio: Tom Stack went to Belfield with Joe Pennell and Gill Kennedy in February 1884. In June 1884 the paper reported that Tobin of Mandan was considering a business partnership with him.

moments.label: Considered for a partnership by Tobin of Mandan

mentions: Joe Pennell, Gill Kennedy and Tom Stack went down to Belfield Monday night.
